issueBlocked.blockedByMany.en: Work on this task is blocked by {{blockerLabel}} until they are complete. Comments still wake the assignee for questions or triage.
issueBlocked.blockedByMany.zh-CN: 此任务被{{blockerLabel}}阻塞，直到它们完成为止。评论仍会唤醒负责人以处理问题或分诊。

issueBlocked.blockedByOne.en: Work on this task is blocked by {{blockerLabel}} until it is complete. Comments still wake the assignee for questions or triage.
issueBlocked.blockedByOne.zh-CN: 此任务被{{blockerLabel}}阻塞，直到它完成为止。评论仍会唤醒负责人以处理问题或分诊。

issueBlocked.blockedNoLinks.en: Work on this task is blocked until it is moved back to todo. Comments still wake the assignee for questions or triage.
issueBlocked.blockedNoLinks.zh-CN: 此任务处于阻塞状态，直到它被移回待办。评论仍会唤醒负责人以处理问题或分诊。

issueBlocked.correctiveWakeQueued.zh-CN: 已为 {{agentName}} 排队纠偏唤醒

issueBlocked.parkedWorkTitle.en: Blocked by parked work - at least one assigned blocker is in backlog and will not wake its assignee.
issueBlocked.parkedWorkTitle.zh-CN: 被搁置的任务阻塞 - 至少一个已分配的阻塞任务仍在待规划状态，不会唤醒负责人。

issueBlocked.recoveryIndicatorTitle.en: {{label}} - open the source issue to act.
issueBlocked.recoveryIndicatorTitle.zh-CN: {{label}} - 打开来源任务进行处理。

issueBlocked.reopenSuppressedMany.en: A message won’t move this back to todo yet — it stays blocked by {{blockerLabel}} until they are done, then it reopens automatically. Comments still wake {{responsibleName}} for questions or triage in the meantime.
issueBlocked.reopenSuppressedMany.zh-CN: 消息暂时不会将此任务移回待办；它仍被{{blockerLabel}}阻塞，全部完成后会自动重新打开。在此期间，评论仍会唤醒{{responsibleName}}处理问题或分诊。

issueBlocked.reopenSuppressedOne.en: A message won’t move this back to todo yet — it stays blocked by {{blockerLabel}} until it is done, then it reopens automatically. Comments still wake {{responsibleName}} for questions or triage in the meantime.
issueBlocked.reopenSuppressedOne.zh-CN: 消息暂时不会将此任务移回待办；它仍被{{blockerLabel}}阻塞，完成后会自动重新打开。在此期间，评论仍会唤醒{{responsibleName}}处理问题或分诊。

issueBlocked.retryNowDescription.en: Corrective wake {{scheduleLabel}}. Retry now starts the same recovery path immediately.
issueBlocked.retryNowDescription.zh-CN: 纠偏唤醒{{scheduleLabel}}。立即重试会马上启动同一条恢复路径。

issueBlocked.stalledMany.en: Work on this task is blocked by {{blockerLabel}}, but the chain is stalled in review without a clear next step. Resolve the stalled reviews below or remove them as blockers.
issueBlocked.stalledMany.zh-CN: 此任务被{{blockerLabel}}阻塞，但阻塞链在评审中停滞，且没有明确下一步。请处理下方停滞的评审，或移除它们的阻塞关系。

issueBlocked.stalledOne.en: Work on this task is blocked by {{blockerLabel}}, but the chain is stalled in review without a clear next step. Resolve the stalled review below or remove it as a blocker.
issueBlocked.stalledOne.zh-CN: 此任务被{{blockerLabel}}阻塞，但阻塞链在评审中停滞，且没有明确下一步。请处理下方停滞的评审，或移除它的阻塞关系。

issueBlocked.success.action.blocked.en: Mark it blocked with a blocker owner.
issueBlocked.success.action.blocked.zh-CN: 将它标记为阻塞，并指定阻塞负责人。

issueBlocked.success.action.delegate.en: Delegate follow-up work or queue a continuation.
issueBlocked.success.action.delegate.zh-CN: 委派后续工作，或排队一个 continuation。

issueBlocked.success.action.done.zh-CN: 将它标记为完成或取消。

issueBlocked.success.action.review.en: Send it for review or ask for input.

issueBlocked.success.bodyPrefix.en: A run finished successfully, but this issue is still open in
issueBlocked.success.bodyPrefix.zh-CN: 一次运行已成功结束，但此任务仍停留在

issueBlocked.success.bodySuffix.en: with no clear owner for the next action.
issueBlocked.success.bodySuffix.zh-CN: 且没有明确的下一步负责人。

issueBlocked.success.title.en: This issue still needs a next step.
issueBlocked.success.title.zh-CN: 此任务仍需要一个下一步。

issueBlocked.waiting.currentTask.en: This task - resumes automatically when the chain is done
issueBlocked.waiting.currentTask.zh-CN: 此任务 - 任务链完成后自动恢复

issueBlocked.waiting.description_one.en: Queued behind {{count}} task being worked in order. This task resumes automatically when the chain is done. Comments still wake the responsible agent.
issueBlocked.waiting.description_one.zh-CN: 排在 {{count}} 个按顺序处理的任务之后。任务链完成后，此任务会自动恢复。评论仍会唤醒负责的智能体。

issueBlocked.waiting.description_other.en: Queued behind {{count}} tasks being worked in order. This task resumes automatically when the chain is done. Comments still wake the responsible agent.
issueBlocked.waiting.description_other.zh-CN: 排在 {{count}} 个按顺序处理的任务之后。任务链完成后，此任务会自动恢复。评论仍会唤醒负责的智能体。

issueBlocked.waiting.title.zh-CN: 正在等待进行中的工作
